description: Generate a 3D model (GLB) from a prompt. 45 credits (game-ready) or 15 (lq draft).

mode.description: game = game-ready, a light clean mesh of about 19k triangles (45 credits); lq = draft (15 credits). hq is an old name for game

style.description: 'low-poly' (default: faceted triangles, flat colours), 'blocky' (voxel art, built from cubes), 'claymation', 'origami', 'hand-painted' (stylized fantasy) or 'toy' (glossy vinyl figure)

type.description: 'character' makes a T-posed figure ready for rigging

name: generate_3d_model
